reviews.author: CravingSoul
reviews.text: This vegetarian restaurant stands out for its spacious layout and ability to comfortably handle large groups, making it a good choice for families and group outings. The interiors are well done and visually appealing, giving the place a neat, organised feel.||||The menu offers a mix of South and North Indian dishes, and we tried a variety of South Indian breakfast items. The food was well prepared, flavourful, and served quickly. Service was efficient throughout, even with a steady flow of diners. There is also a dedicated pan counter, with a wide selection on display, which adds a unique touch to the overall experience.||||Parking can be a bit of a challenge, especially during peak hours, so some patience is required. On weekends, the surrounding area tends to get lively, with many bikers stopping by—adding energy and noise to the atmosphere. This may appeal to some, especially riders on long journeys, but those seeking a quiet breakfast should keep this in mind.||||Overall, it’s a solid breakfast stop for vegetarian food, particularly if you’re travelling in a group or on a long ride and don’t mind a lively setting.

reviews.author: Deepa Bheemaiah
reviews.text:
I’ve been visiting this hotel for the past 13 years, and it has truly become a place that feels like home. Over the years, the warm hospitality, and consistently welcoming atmosphere have kept me coming back.

One of the things I especially appreciate is that the hotel is pet-friendly. It’s wonderful to be able to travel with my furry companion and feel genuinely welcomed rather than having to worry about leaving them behind.

After 13 years of visits, I can confidently say that this hotel holds a special place in my heart. The familiar service, friendly staff, great food and overall experience make every stay enjoyable. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable, welcoming, and pet-friendly place to stay.

reviews.author: Kiran Raj
reviews.text:
On our way to Dharmasthala Temple, my family and I decided to stop at Dhruva Thare Hotel for breakfast, and it turned out to be one of those pleasant surprises you come across during a road trip.

After hours of traveling, all we wanted was a good meal and a place to relax for a while. The moment we walked in, the clean surroundings and welcoming atmosphere made us feel comfortable. The food was served hot and fresh, and every item we ordered tasted delicious. It had that simple, homely flavor that makes a meal truly satisfying when you're on a long journey.

What I appreciated most was the overall experience—not just the food, but the way the place made us feel. It was calm, family-friendly, and the staff were courteous and quick with their service. Sometimes it's the small stops during a trip that become memorable, and this was definitely one of them.

If you're traveling to Dharmasthala with family, this is a wonderful place to take a break, enjoy a hearty meal, and continue your journey with a smile. Highly recommended!

"Good food fills the stomach, but good hospitality makes the journey memorable.

reviews.text:
Stopped at Hotel Dhruvathare during our journey on the Bengaluru–Mangaluru highway and had a good overall experience. The hotel is conveniently located for travelers and makes for a nice break during a long drive.

The place is spacious with plenty of seating and ample parking space available, which is very helpful for families and road-trip travelers. The restaurant area was clean and well maintained.

Food quality and taste were good overall with decent variety available. Service was reasonably quick and staff were polite and attentive. Washrooms were also maintained neatly, which is something travelers especially appreciate on highway stops. The surrounding greenery and open ambience also make the stop feel refreshing compared to crowded highway restaurants.

Pricing felt slightly on the higher side compared to typical highway restaurants, but the cleanliness, ambience and overall experience were good.

Overall, a good and comfortable highway restaurant option if you are travelling between Bengaluru and Mangaluru.

reviews.text:
Hotel Dhruvathare really won me over when I visited for the first time. The outdoor seating area is great and feels very pleasant in the evening with the cool breeze. My favorite part was definitely the bookshelf filled with books by great Kannada authors ❤️. Both the main branch and Dhruvathare 2 are convenient because they both offer plenty of parking, a paan corner, and a kids' play area.
However, when I visited Dhruvathare 2, I felt a bit disappointed by the differences. This branch doesn't have the bookshelf, and the washrooms were just decent, unlike the excellent ones at the main branch. Even the food didn't have the same pleasing taste I enjoyed at the first location. I’m still a big fan of the original Dhruvathare, but the second branch just didn't live up to my expectations.

reviews.author: Anjan Anjan
reviews.text:
unforgettable experience! The atmosphere at hotel dhruvathre is absolutely incredible — vibrant, energetic, and full of excitement. The rides and adventures are top-notch, offering fun for all ages. Every corner is packed with thrill and almost every attraction within minutes, which makes a huge difference to the experience.
Overall, it's a must-visit destination in hotel dhruvathre bangalore to mangalore hihgway and anyone looking to make unforgettable memories. Highly recommended!
